chapter.li: LEChapter5 Verse1 The way in which the wine was administered. They took the cup and said: VerseEnd Verse2 O God the Eternal Father, we ask 2PSI You in the name of 2PSI Your Son Jesus Christ to bless and sanctify this wine for the souls of all those who drink of it, so they can do it in remembrance of 2PSI Your Son’s blood, which was shed for them, so they can show to 2PSI You, O God the Eternal Father, that they always remember Him, so they can have His Spirit to be with them. Amen. VerseEnd
